Watch a Drive folder

Find new files whose name contains "delta"

Read their contents as text

Append those contents into a Google Sheet

And that Sheet can be “Published to the web” so I can read it via a URL with normal browsing (no connectors needed).

So let’s design exactly that do-hopper.

1. Overall pipeline (no connectors, no Gmail, no manual upload)
Write-side (device + Drive)

Termux / PC / whatever creates *.mips.json deltas.
